title: World Cup 2026: Senegal crush 10-man Iraq to remain in hunt for knockout spot
summary: Senegal kept their hopes of qualifying for the World Cup knockouts alive with a thumping 5-0 win over Iraq on Friday as they finished third in Group I behind France and Norway. The Lions of Teranga remain in the hunt for one of the last eight spots in the ⁠round of 32, while Iraq's tournament is over.
